certificate.module_name: Nokia 1830 Photonic Service Switch (PSS) & Nokia 1830 Photonic Service Interconnect- Line (PSI-L)
certificate.caveat: Interim validation. When operated in approved mode.
certificate.description: 1830 Photonic Service Switch (PSS): Scalable optimized end-to-end optical transport solutions for metro, regional and long-haul networks. 1830 Photonic Service Switch - x( PSS -x): Scalable and efficient P-OTN switching for multi-protocol wholesale services. 1830 Photonic Service Interconnect -X (PSI-8L) is a scalable and modular shelf that provides a DataCenter form factor compatible option to deploy Photonic Line configuration.
